instructor:
Marjan Mohammadi is an expert in her field, and she clearly knows a lot and wants to teach all of the things she knows. However, her classes do not go very interactive because I and some others from my class think that she is not tolerant. What I mean is that when you have a comment on a topic that is discussed in the class, she is at first very eager to listen to you, so she allows you to speak. But if she doesn't like your comment, you can feel the judgment in her tone very clearly. I don't think that she does this on purpose, however, she does it. And after that, most of us were hesitant to reply or comment on any of her questions. Also, she sometimes takes a rather very long time to explain herself and what she is thinking about the topic that we are talking about. Sometimes it is better to be precise at first and then elaborate with other comments. Because if someone talks without stopping, it is very hard for the listener to concentrate. 
The last thing I want to talk about is the essay in the final exam. Her criteria begin from the concepts in the book to the use of language. It is very hard to fit an essay to this criteria because the word limit was approximately 750 words. It is harder when one of the criteria is to respect the word count. It is challenging to fit all the ideas related to the essay question in that short essay with all the quotations. However, she also gave us a 2000 word limit for our midterm which was very sufficient. 
Other than these facts, I think she is a very nice person who is passionate about her field. She was very helpful during the times of the earthquake when we had to do our classes online. She knew that there would be less participation in the class, so she posted forums where we had a chance to talk about the book. And that way, we didn't lose any participation points, which affect our total grade.
I believe she will take everything I wrote under consideration and find a way that is beneficial for both her and the students.

Strongest:
Marjan hoca is just PERFECT. She is making a lot of effort to spark a light in the students and improve their worldview. Her energy is unstoppable and she is entering the class with tons of motivation to change the world for the better. :) She is a hardline idealist and, I am sure, works 24/7 to improve herself as well. The way she is interacting with the students is an inspiring approach, especially for the students who are thinking of continuing in academia and looking for inspiration for themselves. She is very respectful to the students and tolerates even the extreme ideas to some extent. I was easily and confidently saying "You are saying X, however, I don't believe in X because of this and this." and she was approaching in a very logical and objective manner. She is not your typical academician who acquires the position in the college and rots afterward, in contrast, she is using her power to interact with the students in a meaningful manner. Unlike many of my previous professors, she has created a free, democratic, and equal space for the exchange of ideas in the class which deeply fascinated me. I am thankful for her efforts.

Weakest:
As I said, Marjan hoca is a hardline idealist. She is deeply in love with her work and believes that everyone can be a logical and decent person with virtues, independent of his/her background. However, this is not always the case. Partly because of the political atmosphere and the corrupted education system, some of the students are coming to Bilkent without any kind of values whatsoever. I think she believes that she can fix them in a semester, but, it is impossible to realize. Sometimes the damage is too large and it is impossible to fix it by a single person, however, she doesn't believe in the limits of her power. I think this is a naive approach which is a product of her kind heart. Unfortunately, it is impossible to change the world on your own, even if it is the world of a single person.

Strongest:
As a sci-fi and dystopia lover myself, the topic of utopias and dystopias is a very interesting one with many real-life parallels. While reading "The Utopia", "The Tempest", "The Communist Manifesto" and "1984", you see the relevance of those utopias/dystopias with our world and current politics. You are thinking about the concepts of war, human value, immigrants, exploitation, surveillance, freedom (of thought, speech, press, etc.), the role of the state, the importance of communities, and individualism/collectivism. Thus, the books are very absorbing and forcing the readers to think deeply. These writings are very crucial for one's personal development and must be read.

She is distributing a reading plan that spans the entire semester with the pages that should be read and it makes the job of the students much easier. I believe that some of the HUM professors should take some lessons from Marjan hoca on organization. :) 

Weakest:
Even though I understand the message of The Tempest, I don't particularly like the humor of Shakespeare. Reading The Tempest might be a good refuge place for students who don't enjoy the dark atmosphere of The Communist Manifesto and 1984, however, it was not for me. I believe that The Tempest might be changed with another book that would better benefit the students. However, it is my humble opinion that must be taken with a grain of salt.

instructor: Marjan Hoca is super kind and easy to talk to. She teaches in a way that makes students question things and find their own answers. I really enjoyed this class thanks to her!

Hocayla başta ilişkilerimiz iyidi güzel ikili diyaloglara giriyordum. Sonra bir anda aramız bozuldu gibi hissetmeye başladım ortada hiçbir olay yokken. Hoca derste bana söz vermemeye başladı karşılıklı bakışmalarımıza rağmen ya da sunum yaparken bir anda sözümü kesti ve tüm sunumumu mahvetti. Bununlada kalmadı presentationda en düşük puanı bana verdi. Başlangıçta bu kadar iyi gözüken bir hoca nedense bir anda hep karşımda duran bir düşman gibi gelmeye başladı bana. Bu da derse olan ilgimi fazlasıyla azalttı. Derse olan ilgimi azaltan bir diğer faktörse Hoca'nın hazırladığı midtermdir. Hoca'nın öteki sectionlarında midterm ortalamaları 25-26 gibi yüksek değerlerdeyken bizim sectionun yanlış hatırlamıyorsam 22 falandı. Bu durumu çözmek için belki tekrar bir midterm falan yapabilirdi veya bizim sectiona ayrı bir ekstra assigment yapabilirdi ama hoca hiçbir şey yapmadı. Bu yüzden en kötü B+ dediğim dersten belkide C alacağım. Kesinlikle ve kesinlikle bu hocadan ders almanızı tavsiye etmiyorum. Pre-regten atarsa dersi droplayın sonraki dönem alın.

Şahsi düşüncelerimdir: 
Ne yazık ki sınıfta eşitlik yok. Hocayla benzer düşünceleri paylaşmıyorsanız muhtemelen düşüncenizin anlamı yok, üstüne üstlük hocanın size takma ihtimali de var. Sadece benim sectionımdan 3 kişi withdraw attı sınıf ortasında rencide edildikten sonra. Bir başka arkadaşımız, sunumu esnasında hiçbir sunumda olmayan derecede bir sorgulanmaya tabi tutuldu ve yine sınıfın ortasında küçüldü. Quizde sorulan saçma sapan, dersin odağından uzaklaşan sorular üstüne üstlük berbat bir puanlandırma da cabası. Neredeyse dersin konusu olan hiçbir kitabı okumanıza gerek yok çünkü sorulan soruların önemli bir çoğunluğu (puan anlamında) kitaptan bağımsız geliyor, ezber bilgiye dayalı. Hatrı sayılır bir mesai harcamama rağmen dersi maksimum B+ ile geçeceğim. Yine de insanlık olarak kötü birisi olduğunu düşünmüyorum ancak öğretmenliği konusunda aynı şeyleri söyleyemiyorum. Sınıfın ortalaması o kadar düşük gelecekti ki mecburen extra task yaptık ortalamayı yükseltmek için. Kesinlikle önceki dönemlerdeki GPA'lere inanmayın ve lütfen uzak durun. Bunlar dışında hocanın bilgisi iyi hem kitaplara hakim hem de akıcı, anlaşılır konuşuyor. Ancak bunlar, saydığım kötü özelliklerin yanında neredeyse umursanmaz oluyor.  Derste yaptığınız yorumların kalitesinin de hiçbir önemi yok, kişisine göre muamele bir kenara, saçma sapan yorumlara bile hoca credit verebiliyor yeter ki bomboş konuşun. Class participation'da kötüyseniz geri kalan notlarınızın iyi olmasını beklemeyin çünkü hoca geri kalan notlarınızı da buna göre değerlendiriyor. Sevmediği biriyseniz, derse katılmakta güçlük çeken biriyseniz muhtemelen iyi bir not alamayacaksınız. Konu bağlamından çok sapılıyor, tartışma farklı yönlere çekilebiliyor ve zaman kötü kullanılıyor hatta birkaç kez spare hour kullandık sırf bu yüzden. Hocanın beklentisi de çok yüksek diye düşünüyorum, özellikle bu saçma sapan dersi zorunluluktan alan biriyseniz muhtemelen gerekli bağlantıları kuramayıp yorumlar yapamayacaksınız.
